hook: Your map shows a piece of Russia between Poland and Lithuania.
title: Russia's Territory Cut Off From Russia
description:
Kaliningrad is a Russian region with no land link to the rest of Russia. Poland and Lithuania sit on its borders, and the Baltic Sea is on the other side. Part of the Places That Shouldn't Exist series.

#Shorts #Geography #PlacesThatShouldntExist
comment_prompt: Would you visit Kaliningrad? Yes or no
